data.title: Hajj Step by Step
data.description: Hajj is the fifth pillar of Islam, due once in a lifetime on every adult Muslim who is able to make the journey: "And [due] to Allah from the people is a pilgrimage to the House, for whoever is able to find thereto a way" (Qur'an 3:97). The Prophet ﷺ said: "Whoever performs Hajj for the sake of Allah, and does not commit obscenity or wrongdoing, returns like the day his mother bore him" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1521, Sahih Muslim 1350). This guide walks through Hajj in order, from preparing at home to the farewell tawaf.

data.title: Complete Umrah Guide
data.description: Umrah can be performed at any time of the year and takes a few hours. The Prophet ﷺ said: "From one Umrah to the next is an expiation for what is between them, and an accepted Hajj has no reward but Paradise" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1773, Sahih Muslim 1349), and "Umrah in Ramadan is equal to Hajj" (Sahih al-Bukhari 1782, Sahih Muslim 1256). It has four parts: ihram, tawaf, sa'i, and shaving or trimming the hair.

data.title: Duas & Adhkar for Hajj and Umrah
data.description: The words the Prophet ﷺ used at each stage of the pilgrimage, with their sources. Beyond these, ask Allah for anything you need, in any language; the pilgrim's du'a is answered, especially on the Day of Arafah.
